The '''Magataran Maelstrom''' was some kind of energy phenomenon in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].

A common phrase was "trapped between the [[Black Hole of Nakat/Legends|Black Hole of Nakat]] and the Magataran Maelstrom."
